name: Cherry Tomato
hook: Yes, you can grow tomatoes on a tiny balcony.

steps.title: Full sun is a must
steps.tip: Pick your sunniest spot. With less than 6 hours of sun, you get few flowers or fruit.

steps.title: Go big on the pot
steps.tip: Use a container of at least 20 L with drainage holes. Small pots dry out too fast.

steps.title: Water deeply, daily
steps.tip: Water at the base each morning in summer. Uneven watering makes the fruit split.

steps.title: Feed once fruit swells
steps.tip: Once the first fruits start to swell, use a high-potassium tomato fertilizer every 10–14 days.

steps.title: Stake and pinch side shoots
steps.tip: Tall, vining types: tie to a stake and pinch off shoots between leaf and stem. Bush types: leave them.

steps.title: Check for aphids
steps.tip: Blast aphids off with a strong spray of water, or use insecticidal soap under the leaves.

outro: Sun, a big pot and steady water: handfuls of sweet tomatoes.

sources.title: UMN Extension: Aphids in home yards and gardens
